description: Renovate only refreshes the pinned base-image digests in the root Dockerfile; Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) owns npm, pip and GitHub Actions updates.

packageRules.description: Base image tags (Node major, PY_VER's Python line, Debian release) are deliberate choices, not routine bumps; see python-nightly-canary.yml for how PY_VER moves. Only refresh the digest behind the current tag.
Refresh all base-image digests in one weekly PR so the Node and Python stages are rebuilt together.
